heroHeadline: South Korea Nominates Han Seong-sook as First Female Prime Minister in Two Decades
heroSubtitle: South Korea nominated Han Seong-sook as the country's first female Prime Minister in two decades, marking a significant political appointment following the ballot shortage controversy that overshadowed the June 3 elections.
